interfaces_or_endpoints: Provider-neutral bounded LanguageModel agent-loop interface with OpenAI tool calls, approved result views, and structured Teams Markdown final replies

One-shot authenticated MCP 1.2.0 discovery retains the bounded read-only allowlist and exposes bot-owned self, exact-selector other-attendance, optional-filter current-status, and directory-safe employee-search policies when their MCP tools are admitted

Authenticated Teams personal-chat flow accepts optional current-status as_of discovery without exposing or forwarding it, splits self and other history up to twelve calendar months into inclusive 31-day windows, pages each window and current status to exhaustion, and prevents model attendance claims before successful tool data
Name search renders deterministic directory-safe candidates and requires a newly messaged listed username or email before a later exact-selector attendance read; resolved IDs remain internal

Two-stage LLM routing makes a pre-auth guidance decision from bot-owned read-only action definitions and an unverified presentation-only Teams display name; safe greeting, clarification, and attendance-only scope guidance end with zero SSO/OBO/MCP/REST activity, while a validated selection enters the existing single SSO/OBO and live MCP catalog admission path

TEAMS-LLM-GUIDANCE-ROUTING-001 verification: `uv run pytest tests/unit/test_authenticated_handler.py tests/unit/test_agent_orchestrator.py tests/unit/test_openai_language_model.py tests/integration/test_authenticated_attendance_flow.py -q` (20 passed), `uv run pytest -q` (136 passed), `uv run ruff check src tests` (passed), `uv run ruff format --check src tests` (54 files already formatted), and `uv run mypy --strict src` (Success: no issues found in 29 source files); MCP 1.2.0 and REST v1 contracts, OBO handling, live-catalog authority, and downstream interfaces are unchanged

TEAMS-TOOL-REPLY-PRESENTATION-001: self/other history, current attendance, and employee search now use explicit bot-owned presentation policies. The model receives reply-safe result shape metadata and can provide only a validated presentation title/context; code renders localized immutable history blocks or status-grouped current names, deterministic search/errors, and validated ordered reply batches. Raw IDs, notes, locations, and source records are omitted. The current-status projection composes REST v1 `first_name` and `last_name` when no display-name field is present. A single Slovenian/English equivalence table covers all database punch labels in both directions and preserves exact database Slovenian labels. MCP 1.2.0 and REST v1 remain unchanged; local verification is recorded in the root handoff.
